voice.name: Open Sector - Landing Ship
voice.description: Male navy officer in his mid forties commanding a landing ship, speaking over a radio and the drone of big diesel engines, steady and unhurried, a gravelly weathered mid-range voice with a warm Canadian accent, calm maritime authority, a seasoned skipper who has run many beach landings.
voice.sample: Wheelhouse here. Beach is three hundred yards off the bow, steady as she goes. Gunners, keep your heads down till we touch bottom. Stand by the bow doors and get those tanks warmed up. Easy now, lads, we've done this before.

die: She's going under... over the side!

fire.prompt: Deck-mounted heavy machine gun on a landing ship firing a short burst, loud rapid hammering .50 caliber reports with brass casings clinking on a steel deck, outdoors at sea, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Big modern landing ship getting under way, twin heavy diesel engines rumbling up with a deep throb, propellers churning water against a flat steel hull, a short low ship horn blast, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: A big steel landing ship torn by a huge explosion at sea, hull plates groaning and breaking apart, secondary blasts, hissing steam and water rushing in as it sinks, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Heavy steel bow doors of a modern landing ship grinding open on rusty hinges with a chain winch rattling, then a massive steel ramp dropping down onto a sandy beach with a loud metallic clang and thud, close, no music, no voice
